title: DOW-UAP-D55, Mission Report, Syria, November 2016
doc_notes: This document is a declassified mission report from USCENTCOM detailing a P-8A sensor observation of an unidentified object near Latakia, Syria, in November 2016.

incidents.summary: P-8A aircraft observed an unidentified low-flying object via EO/IR sensor traveling at 500 knots in sea skim mode.
incidents.quote: The possible missile appeared to be in sea skim mode traveling at approximately 500KTS
